notes: ProofHouse is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Proof House (PH) with 18 decimals. Its no-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 PH once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no administrative privileges, transfer fees or externally callable mint or burn functions. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply.
